title: Kopernikusstraße, Augsburg
description:
91 qm Wohnfläche mit eigenem 400 qm Garten zur alleinigen Nutzung. Im Garten ist ein Gartenhaus mit Loungemöbeln. Der Garten ist von außen nicht einsehbar und lässt sich abschließen. 

Die Wohnung verfügt über 4 Schlafzimmer und ein Esszimmer.
Die Schlafzimmer sind voll möbliert mit Schrank und Schreibtisch. Jedes ist auch z.B. als Kinderzimmer oder Arbeitszimmer nutzbar.
Drei Schlafzimmer verfügen über 0,90x2,00m Betten und das große Schlafzimmer über ein 1,40x2,00m Bett.

Das Bad ist mit einer Wannendusche ausgestattet.

Im Keller ist ein separater Waschraum mit Waschmaschine und Trockner.

Stellplätze gibt es kostenfrei an der Straße. Hier ist immer ein Parkplatz zu finden.

title: Neuburger Straße, Augsburg
description:
🏡 Spacious & Bright Room with Balcony in Modern Shared Apartment – Augsburg

Hello dear apartment seekers!

We are offering a beautiful and spacious 30 sqm furnished room in a recently renovated 85 sqm shared apartment in Augsburg.

The apartment consists of:• 3 bedrooms• Bathroom with bathtub and shower• Separate toilet• Spacious kitchen-living area with dining table• Central hallway with additional storage space

⸻

🛏️ Your Room

Your bright and cozy room offers plenty of natural light thanks to its two large windows and beautiful parquet flooring.

The room comes fully furnished with:• IKEA Hemnes pull-out bed (160x200 cm)• Wardrobe• Desk and chair with a beautiful courtyard view

⸻

🛋 Apartment Features

The apartment was fully renovated last year and is equipped with everything needed for comfortable everyday living.

The kitchen includes:• Refrigerator• Dishwasher• Microwave• Dining table• Fully equipped kitchen essentials

A washer-dryer is also available and can be shared by all flatmates.

The apartment layout is very practical, as every room is directly accessible from the central hallway. Built-in wardrobes provide additional storage space throughout the apartment.

The daylight bathroom includes both a bathtub and a separate shower.

You would be sharing the apartment with:

We enjoy a relaxed and respectful shared-flat atmosphere. We like cooking together, chatting in the kitchen, or spending relaxed evenings together — while also fully respecting everyone’s privacy and quiet time.

Optional activities together may include:• Sports• Bike rides• Jogging• Beer gardens• Going out or social evenings

Of course, nothing is mandatory — everyone should feel comfortable and at home.

⸻

📍 Excellent Location – Augsburg Lechhausen

The apartment is located in Augsburg-Lechhausen, one of Augsburg’s best-connected residential areas, combining quiet living with excellent infrastructure and fast access to the city center.

Nearby you will find:• Supermarkets & shops for daily needs• Pharmacies, doctors & banks• Restaurants & cafés• Fitness studios• Schools, university facilities & public services

🚍 Excellent Public Transport & Connectivity• Bus stop “Steinerne Furt” only 2 minutes away• Approx. 19 minutes to Augsburg main station by bus• Quick access to the B2 and A8 motorway towards Munich or Stuttgart

Walking distances:• 2 minutes to public transport• 3 minutes to supermarkets• 7 minutes to the gym

⸻

🌟 Why You’ll Love This Apartment

• Bright and spacious room with balcony• Recently renovated apartment• Fully furnished & move-in ready• Relaxed and friendly flatshare atmosphere• Great connection to the city center and universities• Quiet yet central location

⸻

If you are interested, feel free to send us a short message about yourself — who you are, what you do, and what you are looking for. We look forward to hearing from you!

title: Mauerberg, Augsburg
description:
Zur Vermietung steht ab 01.12.2023 eine kürzlich komplett renovierte ca. 70qm und voll eingerichtete Wohnung im Herzen von Augsburg.

Sie ist durch ihre Aufteilung sowohl für Singles als auch für Paare gut geeignet.

Vom 9qm großen Flur gehen alle Zimmer ab.

Im großzügigen 18qm Schlafzimmer, welches mit einem 1,60 Meter großem Bett,  einem großen Kleiderschrank und einer Kommode ausgestattet ist, hat ebenfalls ein großer Schreibtisch Einzug erhalten um auch das Arbeiten aus dem Homeoffice angenehm zu gestalten.

Die 12qm große Küche bietet neben Allem was eine Küche so ausmacht zusätzlich einen großen Essplatz.

Das modernisierte 7 qm Tageslicht Bad verfügt nicht nur über ein großes Fenster sondern auch über eine Badewanne und eine Waschmaschine.

Im größten Raum, dem 20qm großen  Wohnzimmer lädt eine gemütliche Couch zum Entspannen oder eine Sitzecke zu Spieleabenden ein.

Außerdem geht noch eine 4 qm große Abstellkammer vom Flur ab, welche mit eingebauten Regalbrettern viel Stauraum bereit hält.

Die Wohnung befindet sich im Hochparterre eines 20 Parteien Hauses. Das Haus ist am Ende einer kleinen Sackgasse gelegen und somit sehr ruhig.

Trotz der ruhigen Lage ist man fußläufig in nur wenigen Gehminuten an den zentralsten Plätzen Augsburg wie dem Alten Stadtbad, dem Kino oder auch dem Dom und Rathausplatz.
 

In der Wohnung sind alle Böden/Türen/Lampen und die Küche erneuert und mit einer hochwertigen Ausstattung liebevoll eingerichtet worden.

title: Widderstraße, Augsburg
description:
Fully furnished room – all utilities, Wi-Fi and Anmeldung included.
International WG · Fixed all-inclusive rent · No extra costs · Quiet working environment · Excellent public transport · Close to the city & the river

Your new home in Augsburg-Lechhausen

Welcome to our fully furnished 6-bedroom shared apartment (WG) in Augsburg-Lechhausen – a great choice for international students, dual-study students, interns, Erasmus students and young professionals looking for a comfortable and uncomplicated place to live.

The apartment offers six private bedrooms and three bathrooms, providing plenty of space and comfort for everyone. The shared kitchen is fully equipped and serves as the central communal area of the WG. It includes everything you need for everyday life, including a dishwasher, two refrigerators, an oven and plenty of storage and workspace.

One of the bathrooms is equipped with both a washing machine and dryer, so you can easily take care of your laundry at home.

International & welcoming WG

This is an international shared apartment, bringing together people from different countries and backgrounds. The goal is to create a friendly, respectful and relaxed WG atmosphere where everyone can feel at home.

At the same time, the apartment offers a quiet environment for studying and working from home.

Great location

The apartment is very well connected by public transport, with easy access to the tram network. You can reach Augsburg city centre quickly while still enjoying the benefits of a quieter residential area.

And when you need a break from studying or working, nature is close by: the river and surrounding green areas are easily accessible, making it perfect for jogging, walking or simply getting some fresh air.

Everything included

The rent is a fixed all-inclusive monthly rent. This means:

* Fully furnished private room
* Fully equipped shared kitchen
* Wi-Fi
* All utilities
* Washing machine & dryer
* Anmeldung possible
* No additional or hidden costs

Just move in, unpack and feel at home.

Ideal for: International students · Erasmus students · Dual-study students · Interns · Young professionals · Professionals relocating to Augsburg

title: Olympiastraße, Augsburg
description:
Premium Work & Living Apartment Augsburg – Vintage Edition

61.58 m2 | Fully Furnished | Dedicated Home Office | Air Conditioning | South-Facing Balcony | Private Parking

Arrive. Work. Relax. Rediscover the Good Old Days.

Welcome to our exceptional Premium Work & Living Apartment in the heart of Augsburg-Haunstetten, Germany.

A home away from home that combines the charm of past decades with the comfort and convenience of modern living.

A place designed for people who travel for work, appreciate thoughtful details, and want more than just somewhere to sleep after a long day.

Whether you're an international project manager, engineer, business consultant, IT specialist, executive, or professional on a temporary assignment, our apartment offers everything you need for a productive, comfortable, and relaxing stay.

Come in. Connect your laptop. Feel at home.

Work – Your Fully Equipped Home Office

When you're away from home on business, you shouldn't have to compromise on productivity or comfort.

That's why our apartment features a dedicated, fully equipped workspace designed for today's professionals.

With a monitor, headset, webcam, charging stations, and essential office accessories, all you need to do is connect your laptop and get started.

High-speed Wi-Fi keeps you connected, whether you're attending international video conferences, managing projects, working remotely, or collaborating with colleagues around the world.

Your workspace is ready when you are.

And when the working day is over?

That's when the other side of our apartment comes to life.

Living – Take a Little Journey Back in Time

Sit back, relax, and take a little journey into the past.

Back to the decades when life somehow seemed a little simpler. When we took more time to appreciate the small things that often get lost in today's fast-paced, constantly connected world.

Put on a CD you haven't listened to in years. No streaming subscription, no digital playlist, and no need to worry about your internet connection.

Pick up a movie from our collection. Perhaps a childhood favorite, a classic from your teenage years, a fun blockbuster, or a philosophical masterpiece that stays with you long after the credits have rolled.

Or simply reach for a book.

A real book, made of paper.

Feel the pages between your fingers, turn them one by one, and lose yourself in a story without notifications, messages, or screens demanding your attention.

And if you grew up in the 1980s, 1990s, or 2000s, why not pick up a game controller again?

Rediscover the video games that once kept you entertained for hours.

Remember those afternoons when reaching the next level seemed like the most important thing in the world, until your parents reminded you that life existed beyond the television screen?

Perhaps you'll rediscover a little of that feeling here.

Our carefully curated and continuously expanding media library includes books, CDs, movies, and video games from different decades.

It's an invitation to revisit the music, stories, and entertainment that shaped generations.

Because sometimes, a little journey into the past is exactly what we need to appreciate the present.

Comfort – Everything You Need. Nothing You Have to Arrange.

Our apartment has been fully furnished and thoughtfully equipped to make your stay as comfortable and effortless as possible.

With 61.58 m2 of living space, it offers two welcoming rooms, including a separate bedroom with two individual single beds and a comfortable living area with an additional sofa bed.

Modern amenities and carefully selected furnishings ensure that you have everything you need from the moment you arrive.

Living & Relaxation

•	Fully furnished two-room apartment
•	Separate bedroom with two single beds
•	Comfortable living room with sofa bed
•	Air conditioning for warm summer days and comfortable nights
•	50-inch television
•	Stereo system and Blu-ray player
•	Video game consoles
•	Extensive collection of books, music, movies, and video games
•	Cozy relaxation corner

Work & Connectivity

•	Dedicated, fully equipped home office workstation
•	External monitor, headset, and webcam
•	Charging stations and office accessories
•	High-speed Wi-Fi
•	Ideal setup for remote work, business calls, and online meetings

Kitchen & Household

•	Fully equipped kitchen
•	Dishwasher
•	Refrigerator and freezer
•	Microwave
•	Fully automatic coffee machine
•	Electric kettle and toaster
•	Cookware, dishes, cutlery, and kitchen utensils
•	Washing machine and tumble dryer
•	Iron and ironing board

Outdoor Living & Mobility

•	South-facing balcony for relaxing and unwinding
•	Barbecue facilities
•	Private parking space

There's no need to purchase furniture, arrange household appliances, or worry about everyday essentials.

Simply bring your personal belongings.

We've taken care of the rest.

Location – Peaceful Living. Excellent Connections. Close to Business.

Our apartment is located in the heart of Augsburg-Haunstetten, close to the beautiful Siebentischwald and the extensive Augsburg City Forest (a Forest Preserve).

The location combines a peaceful residential environment with excellent everyday convenience.

Supermarkets, medical facilities, shops, and essential public services are all within easy walking distance.

Public transportation connections provide convenient access to Augsburg and the surrounding area, while major roads and highways are easily accessible by car.

An ideal location for international professionals and corporate assignments.

Augsburg-Haunstetten is conveniently located near important industrial and technology centers in the Augsburg region.

The area is home to companies and facilities operating in aerospace, mechanical engineering, manufacturing, automation, and other advanced technology sectors.

This makes our apartment particularly attractive to engineers, executives, project managers, consultants, and technical specialists working temporarily in Augsburg or the surrounding region.

A private parking space adds convenience for professionals who travel between offices, production facilities, and project locations.

Discover – Experience Augsburg and Southern Bavaria

If your work brings you to Augsburg, why not take the opportunity to discover one of Germany's most fascinating regions?

With more than 2,000 years of history, Augsburg offers a unique combination of historical architecture, culture, art, music, and excellent cuisine.

Explore the charming old town, discover its winding streets, visit museums and historic landmarks, or simply enjoy a coffee in one of the city's welcoming cafés.

The nearby Siebentischwald is perfect for walking, jogging, cycling, and enjoying nature.

Munich is easily accessible by public transportation, while the beautiful Bavarian Alpine foothills and the Alps offer wonderful opportunities for day trips.

Throughout the year, concerts, cultural events, traditional Christmas markets, summer festivals, and local celebrations provide plenty of opportunities to experience Bavarian life.

And if you would rather stay home after a busy day?
That's perfectly fine, too.

Spend a warm summer evening on the south-facing balcony, enjoy a glass of wine, prepare something delicious on the barbecue, or rediscover a classic movie from our media library.

Here, you don't have to do anything. But you can do almost everything.

Stay – Your Home Away from Home

Our Premium Work & Living Apartment is designed for professionals who need comfortable, fully equipped accommodation during temporary assignments in Augsburg and the surrounding region.

It's particularly suitable for:

•	International project managers and executives
•	Engineers and technical specialists
•	Business consultants and IT professionals
•	Employees on temporary corporate assignments
•	Professionals relocating for a limited period
•	Business travelers on extended stays
•	Professional couples or colleagues traveling together

We particularly welcome stays of three to six months, although longer rental periods can also be arranged.

Whether you're spending a few months working on a major industrial project, supporting a local company, or temporarily relocating to Augsburg, our apartment offers the convenience of a fully equipped home combined with a distinctive and welcoming atmosphere.

More Than an Apartment – A Place to Feel at Home

Our Vintage Work & Living Apartment is more than just a furnished rental.
It's a thoughtfully created living experience for people who appreciate both professional productivity and personal well-being.

A place where you can focus on your work, unwind after a demanding day, and rediscover a little of the nostalgia that makes life's quieter moments so special.

Modern technology meets the charm of past decades.

Professional functionality meets comfort and relaxation.
And every detail has been chosen with one goal in mind: making your stay feel as comfortable and welcoming as possible.

If there's anything you need or a special request we can help with, simply let us know. We'll do our best to make your time in Augsburg a pleasant and memorable experience.

Work smart. Live comfortably. Rediscover the good old days.

We look forward to welcoming you to your home away from home in Augsburg.
